blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — A medal remained elusive for the Philippines on the fourth day of the Asian Games 2026 swimming competition after Gian Santos and Xiandi Chua missed the podium on Wednesday at Tokyo Aquatics Center. Santos placed 10th and last in the men’s 200m freestyle final, clocking 1:49.80. Zhanshuo Zhang of China set a new Asian record of 1:43.49 to win gold. South Korea’s Hwang Sunwoo came in as the runner up with 1:44.62, while Tatsuya Murasa of Japan held on to the bronze at 1:44.81. Santos set […]...
